_source: computed styles at 1440/360 (computed-*.json) + theme CSS (current/assets/css/style-3.css, theme.min-3.css) of https://balbriggan.ie/

font.heroHeading: 'Gotham Bold', Helvetica, Arial, Lucida, sans-serif (undefined face on source → renders the Helvetica/Arial fallback)

type.h2Section: 32px/38.4px GothamBold, weight 500, uppercase, #3c3c3c, centred; ::after 10% wide 5px #ff0 rule, margin .5em auto 1.5em
type.h2Hero: 28px/33.6px, weight 700, letter-spacing 1px, uppercase, #3c3c3c; ::after 10% rule margin 14px auto 42px
type.mainNav: 12px/18px Gotham-Light uppercase #f5ee2f, padding 8px, li margin 0 1.6px (1200–1469 range: font-size .75rem)

button.secondary: bg #f5ee2f, color #2494d2, 16px/24px GothamMedium weight 700 uppercase, padding 2.4px 32px, border 2px solid #f5ee2f, radius 32px; hover bg #2494d2 color #fff
button.submit: bg #f5ee2f color #2494d2, 16px weight 700 uppercase, padding 8px 24px, border 2px, radius 4px

layout.header: sticky, 98px @1440 (padding 8px 16px, logo 176×72), 90px @360 (logo 142×48); scrolled>100px: logo 9rem×3.5rem, navbar padding .1rem 16px
layout.hero: height 70vh, overlay #009bd9 multiply, card max-width 592px padding 48px (mobile 48px 32px margin 32px)
layout.newsCard: 380px slides (3-up, all widths), card radius 24px, image 9rem
layout.grid: repeat(4,1fr), gap 20px, rows 15vw, first item spans 2×2
layout.footer: #444, padding 30px 0; fcc logo 192×192 left, social + Privacy right

textRendering: browser defaults (no smoothing / text-rendering overrides on body)
